title: “I am bad”: Interpreting Stealthy, Universal and Robust Audio Jailbreaks in Audio-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and robustness of Audio-Language Models (ALMs) against adversarial jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates the effectiveness of bypassing 'safety alignment' (which is based on ethical guidelines to prevent harm and bias), the study's primary contribution is in the technical domain of adversarial machine learning and the interpretability of audio-based attacks, rather than a direct evaluation of religious or formal moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
